title: Runtime Projection and Grant Receipts
objective: Produce a deterministic current species contribution from base species + lineage + form + adaptations + campaign adjudications.
acceptance: temporary state does not corrupt base selection
boundaries: MVPS-13 owns deterministic current species-contribution projection and species-origin grant receipt composition only; canonical shared mechanic owners retain their state and execution authority.
Projection must consume the exact-version SpeciesDefinition and preserved CharacterSpeciesSelection history established by MVPS-01 through MVPS-12.
Lineage, form, adaptation, campaign adjudication and shared-owner contribution ordering must remain explicit and reproducible; unresolved or migration-required inputs may not be silently normalized.
Temporary form/runtime state may affect the current projection but may not rewrite base species, lineage, historical choices or migration receipts.
Authoring/search/presentation remains MVPS-14; NPC/creature reuse remains MVPS-15; radical-species golden proof remains MVPS-16.
MVPS-14+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.

selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MSAS-05 and MRCS-03 remain independently selected_not_started.
